description: This Java interface defines configuration parameters for a pub/sub system, including methods to create config instances from different sources and an enum for default values.

classes.name: PubSubConfig
classes.description: Interface for pub/sub configuration parameters, including methods to instantiate configs and an enum for default values.

classes.name: ConfigValue
classes.description: Enum implementing KnownConfigValue, holding default configuration values and paths for pub/sub settings.

methods.name: getSeed
methods.description: Returns the seed used for hash functions shared across the cluster.

methods.name: getHashFamilySize
methods.description: Returns the number of hash functions used for Bloom filters.

methods.name: getRestartDelay
methods.description: Returns the duration to wait before restarting pub/sub actors after a crash.

methods.name: getUpdateInterval
methods.description: Returns how often distributed data is updated.

methods.name: getForceUpdateProbability
methods.description: Returns the probability of forcing an update on each clock tick.
